requires: Proximity attribution v3 reported; owner approval; sizes recorded before any position model is fitted
question: Can a model that maps EEG only to list position, then copies the text of training sentences at that position, match the v1 CNN at 10-way on the same queries?

protected.policy: v1 test sentences, v2 test blocks and their buffers are never fitted or scored; a run-time audit refuses to continue otherwise

split.source: The v1 sentence holdout split, seed 42, with the v2 test zone removed from training and validation

bridge.model: Ridge per release from features to sentence ID; no text enters the fit
bridge.alpha_selection: Lowest absolute position error on a seeded 15% of training sentences, then refit on all training sentences
arms: shuffled positions, permuted by sentence within release, mean of 10

reference.model: Saved v1 real-EEG CNN, best checkpoint and stored normalizer, re-predicted on the kept queries; no refit

evaluation.primary: Expected 10-way top-1, kept queries against the kept pool per release, reader-macro, ties are misses
secondary: Spearman correlation of CNN and bridge scores across sentences

decision_rule.beats_shuffled: Gap over shuffled at least 2 points, with reader and sentence 97.5% lower bounds above 0

outcomes.condition: Beats shuffled and bridge within 2 points of the CNN or above it
outcomes.label: Position alone could account for the CNN score

outcomes.condition: Beats shuffled and bridge more than 2 points below the CNN
outcomes.label: Position explains part of the CNN score

random_splits.scope: Text only, with v1 test sentences and the v2 test zone removed first

sentence_id_check: IDs are per-reader MATLAB sentence indices. Report missing-sentence runs per reader; presentation order is not otherwise recorded in the manifests
test_policy: No final test data is scored
stop_rule: Stop after this run whatever the outcome. No extra settings or models under this plan.
existing_output_policy: Refuse to run if the output directory exists; hash protected prior artifacts before and after
